tasks.description: Create an endpoint that accepts email and password for registration. Validate email format and password length. Reject registration if email is already in use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email and password, when registering, then a new user account is created.
Given an email that is already in use, when registering, then registration is rejected.
Given an invalid email or password, when registering, then registration is rejected with an error message.

tasks.description: Use bcrypt to hash passwords before storing them in the database. Never store or log plaintext passwords.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user account, when storing the password, then the password is hashed using bcrypt.
Given a stored password, when retrieving it, then the password is not in plaintext.

tasks.description: Create an endpoint that accepts email and password for login. Verify the password against the stored bcrypt hash and reject invalid credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid email and password, when logging in, then a successful login response is returned.
Given invalid email or password, when logging in, then a generic error message is returned.

tasks.description: On successful login, issue a signed JWT access token that encodes the user identity and an expiry.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when issuing a JWT token, then the token contains the user identity and an expiry.
Given a JWT token, when verifying it, then the token is valid and not expired.

tasks.description: Create an endpoint that ends the user's session so the token can no longer be used for authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid JWT token, when logging out, then the token is invalidated and can no longer be used for authenticated requests.

tasks.description: Validate email format and password length during registration. Reject registration if email is already in use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid email, when registering, then registration is rejected with an error message.
Given a password with less than 8 characters, when registering, then registration is rejected with an error message.

tasks.summary: Write unit tests for auth endpoints
tasks.description: Write unit tests to cover the registration, login, and logout endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when running the tests, then all tests pass and cover the required scenarios.
